- Species labels were clean (no variants or misspellings), and there were no duplicate rows.
- Caveat: island column has minor case/space variants ("torgersen", "Dream ") and body_mass_g has 3 values written as text, but neither affects this question. 2 rows have missing sex, which is also irrelevant here.
